title: FAMAS clarifies Maricel Soriano, Maris Racal awards

blocks.text: The organization behind the Filipino Academy of Movie Arts and Sciences (FAMAS) Awards clarified Wednesday the distinction between the acting awards received by Maricel Soriano and Maris Racal following apparent confusion over their respective wins.
